events.description:
Ask anyone shipping agents what matters most in the development lifecycle, and the answer keeps coming back to evaluations and the data that underlies them. Good evals drive progress for application companies and frontier labs alike.
Join SPC's Post-Training forum for a technical and product-focused conversation with LangChain's Co-Founder and CTO, Ankush Gola, one of the leading experts in agent evaluation.
